faq.title: Questions
faq.lead: A few plain answers about this public snapshot.

items.a: No. Qing List lines up public bestseller pages that were open on 15 October 2026, so you can compare names, prices, and ratings. Order from the merchant only after you check the live page.
Amazon.com, Dame, Lovense, We-Vibe, Womanizer, and Waddy in Hong Kong. Shops that could not be opened are listed at the bottom. Nothing was added to fill a gap.
They are the figures from that day’s snapshot. Stock, discounts, and ranks move, so treat this as a record, not a live quote.
Adults aged 18 and over. It is not medical or health advice, and it is not a suggestion that you should buy.
